events.title: Grounded spec built
events.reasoning: The evidence from prd-procol-sourcing.md and catalog.json confirms Procol supports the full workflow: creating multi-stage sourcing events (RFP/RFQ/auction), inviting vendors, placing bids, and awarding, plus team-based user management. The one spec-vs-product gap worth testing is the phone field: the PRD specifies a 10-digit number, but the backend only validates length, not whether the input contains digits. This mismatch means non-numeric 10-character strings could be accepted, so we should test that boundary.

deltas.prdSays: Accept any 10-digit number; reject malformed input politely (PRD §4.3, §5).
deltas.productDoes: The API checks phone LENGTH (rejects 9 or 11 digits) but NOT that characters are digits — it accepts a 10-char value containing letters. The frontend enforces digits-only, so the API is more lenient than the UI.
